regions.merged_text: And - shame on us stupid "Christians" - in the light of Mary the Queen of Martyrs, the Immaculate Virgin Mother of God actually at the foot of the Cross offering herself together with her divine Son - her God and her Son - for the salvation of fallen humanity! O dear Mr. Morgan! Where is our faith? Where our foresight? Where our generous cooperation with opportunities of graces that Almighty God is always providing for our best? For indeed and at all times: "God condescends to use our powers. -- If we don't spoil His plans by ours." Again and again He must repeat to each one of us: " ... Unless you see signs and wonders you believe not." How is it that, though we can lookback fifty, seventy years as if it were but yesterday, we still figure on the endurance of human plans? We want to be Christians - spouses of Jesus - risen and glorified of course, but without getting too near the Cross of pain! ? Is it not time indeed that we pray for one another's conversion?
